title: Earlier states avoid the exit set
statement: Let $N$ be a $k$-work-tape machine, let $F$ be a set of possible states (including the halted state), and let $P$ be a property of the work-tape head positions. If a run of $N$ from configuration $a$ reaches configuration $b$ after $t$ steps, avoids $F$ at every time strictly before $t$, and satisfies $P$ at every time through $t$, then in particular its state lies outside $F$ at every time strictly before $t$.
hypotheses_covered: The run from $a$ reaches $b$ after $t$ steps
The run's states avoid $F$ at every time before $t$
The work-tape head positions satisfy $P$ at every time through $t$
